title: tsfore results site: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Forecast Discussion. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Forecast Discussion
options.lineage: NWS Area Forecast Discussions and SPC outlook maps
options.thesis: Forecasters reporting on forecasters: a dated discussion with synopsis, confidence, amendments and an extended outlook.
options.viewport: A product header (ISSUED 2026-10-18, AREA: 11 FINANCE SERIES) over a SYNOPSIS paragraph and an outlook map of 11 series tinted by which family wins.
options.risk: Monospace walls tire the eye if prose blocks run long; needs a proportional reading face for body text.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Every one of 744 scored windows drawn as a hairline bar; the summary is what the field adds up to.
options.case: Strong on density and honesty; weaker on clarity for a reader who wants the verdict first.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Each series a plate, each model a star sized by skill.
options.case: Fuses: rank as magnitude reads naturally; but a sky metaphor is foreign to forecasters.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Findings as frames on a rail; overturned claims hang on pins below, still visible.
options.case: Corrections-on-pins fits the honesty principle well; fuses poorly because film editing means nothing to this audience.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An ML benchmark results page: leaderboard table, bar charts, findings and methodology.
canonCard.viewport: Title and one-line verdict over a sortable leaderboard, charts below.
canonCard.risk: Familiar to the point of forgettable.
